stem.text: A nucleus W of a radioactive isotope emits a $\beta^{-}$ particle and forms nucleus X.
Nucleus X emits an $\alpha$-particle to form nucleus Y.
Nucleus Y emits a $\beta^{-}$ particle to form nucleus Z.
Which statement about Z is correct?

A.text: Z is a nucleus of a different element from W and has a higher nucleon number.

B.text: Z is a nucleus of a different element from W and has a lower nucleon number.

C.text: Z is a nucleus of the same element as W and has a higher nucleon number.

D.text: Z is a nucleus of the same element as W and has a lower nucleon number.
